learnings: Defaults are evaluated once; immutable defaults are safe, mutable ones are not.
`*drinks` collects positional arguments into a tuple; `**extras` collects keywords into a dict.
Google-style docstrings with Args/Returns/Raises make `help()` genuinely useful.
pitfalls: Unknown keyword extras were silently accepted – they are now rejected with a clear message.
